run_egoexo_download_cli: run the egoexo CLI to download Ego4D v2 dataset parts to a local output directory
download_egoexo_with_parts: download specific EgoExo dataset parts like annotations and point clouds using the CLI
download_egoexo_filtered_uids: download EgoExo data filtered by specific user IDs using the --uids flag
download_egoexo_all_parts: download all EgoExo dataset parts including metadata, captures, takes, and annotations
download_egoexo_with_s3_profile: download EgoExo dataset using a custom S3 profile for authenticated access
